item.title: [New] Intune raises the minimum iOS/iPadOS Company Portal to v5.2608.0 from early December; devices that block App Store installs need a pushed update
item.description:
A device stuck on an older Company Portal can fall out of enrolment and compliance flows, which Conditional Access device-compliance policies depend on.

Intune · If 'Block installing apps using App Store' is enabled for supervised iOS/iPadOS devices, push Company Portal v5.2608.0 before early December; warn the help desk about the update prompt.

item.title: [Message Center] MC1547994 Plan for Change: Update your iOS/iPadOS Company Portal minimum version to v5.2608.0
item.description:
Starting early December, the minimum iOS/iPadOS Company Portal version will be v5.2608.0 to support new Apple OS releases. Most users update automatically; others will be prompted. If app installation is blocked via device restrictions, manual updates may be needed. Prepare helpdesk for update prompts.

item.title: [Message Center] MC1546354 Discover usage-based billing (UBB) experiences like Cowork, Code, and Autopilot
item.description:
Usage-based billing experiences like Cowork, Code, and Autopilot will be visible by default to Microsoft 365 Copilot licensed users starting January 2027. New admin controls will allow organizations to manage access requests and provide custom guidance URLs. Existing spending policies still govern actual usage and billing.
